strategy_rules.first_touch: 15m high-low intersects frozen prior closed 15m EMA20
strategy_rules.touch_confirmation: touch candle closes on trend side of both prior and finished EMA20
strategy_rules.reclaim_confirmation: first touch candle closes on wrong side of both prior and finished EMA20; subsequent bar closes back on trend side
strategy_rules.combined_mode: the same first touch can form immediate touch-close OR initiate a later reclaim, never both
strategy_rules.optional_1h_alignment: last completed 1h Supertrend trend same direction
strategy_rules.excludes: funding, liquidation, depth, spread, tick order, live latency
